Honey Banana.genetics: Honey Boo Boo  x  Banana OG
Honey Banana.lineage: Granddaddy Purple  x  Bukake -> Honey Boo Boo | Banana Kush  x  OG Kush -> Banana OG
Honey Banana.flavor: Sweet honey, ripe banana, tropical fruit
Honey Banana.description: A smooth hybrid that wraps you in sweetness. The Honey Boo Boo parentage brings deep relaxation while Banana OG adds uplifting euphoria.

Ice Cream Cookies.genetics: Ice Cream Cake  x  Girl Scout Cookies
Ice Cream Cookies.lineage: Gelato 33  x  Wedding Cake -> Ice Cream Cake | OG Kush  x  Durban Poison -> GSC
Ice Cream Cookies.description: A dessert-forward indica that hits like a warm blanket. The Gelato lineage brings creamy smoothness while GSC genetics deliver the punch.

Jelly Donutz.lineage: Mendo Breath  x  Do-Si-Dos -> Jelly Breath | Face Off OG  x  OGKB -> Dosidos
Jelly Donutz.flavor: Sweet berry jam, doughy, sugar glaze
Jelly Donutz.description: Named for its impossibly sweet, pastry-like flavor. The Mendo Breath genetics bring heavy body relaxation and a sweet, jammy exhale.

Orange Creampop.lineage: Orange Juice  x  GSC -> Orange Cookies | Starfighter  x  GSC -> Cookies & Cream
Orange Creampop.flavor: Citrus burst, vanilla cream, sweet orange
Orange Creampop.description: Like biting into a frozen creamsicle on a summer day. The Orange Cookies parentage delivers bright citrus while the Cookies & Cream adds a creamy finish.

Skittlez.lineage: Mendocino Purps  x  Afghani -> Grape Ape | Grapefruit (Cinderella 99 pheno)
Skittlez.description: The legendary Zkittlez delivers a rainbow of fruit flavors. Grape Ape brings the purple color and calm, while Grapefruit genetics add citrusy uplift.

Triple Cake.lineage: Triangle Kush  x  Animal Mints -> Triangle Mints | Cherry Pie  x  GSC -> Wedding Cake
Triple Cake.description: Triple the cake, triple the hit. Triangle Mints brings minty gas while Wedding Cake adds layers of sweet, doughy flavor with potent effects.

Afghan Kush.lineage: Pure landrace indica -- one of cannabis' oldest cultivated strains, originating from the mountainous border of Afghanistan and Pakistan
Afghan Kush.description: A pure landrace strain from the Hindu Kush mountain range. Thousands of years of natural selection created this bulletproof indica -- the genetic backbone of countless modern hybrids.

AK-47.genetics: Colombian  x  Mexican  x  Thai  x  Afghan
AK-47.lineage: A complex sativa-dominant blend of South American, Mexican, Thai, and Afghani landraces -- first crossed in 1992 by Serious Seeds in the Netherlands
AK-47.description: Despite its intense name, AK-47 delivers a mellow, steady cerebral buzz. Four landrace genetics combine to create one of the most awarded strains in cannabis history.

Blue Dream.lineage: Afghani  x  Thai  x  Purple Thai -> Blueberry | Colombian Gold  x  Thai  x  Mexican  x  South Indian -> Haze
Blue Dream.description: California's most iconic strain. The legendary DJ Short Blueberry brings sweet berry flavor while Haze genetics deliver soaring, clear-headed energy. The perfect balance.

Cap Junky.lineage: GSC  x  Alien Dawg -> Alien Cookies | Bubba Kush  x  Animal Mints -> Kush Mints
Cap Junky.flavor: Minty gas, earthy funk, sweet cream
Cap Junky.description: A top-shelf powerhouse crossing two cookie-family heavyweights. Alien Cookies brings the funk while Kush Mints adds a frosty, gassy edge. Extremely high THC.

Chernobyl.lineage: Mexican  x  Thai  x  Afghani -> Trainwreck | Jack's Cleaner  x  Space Queen -> Jack the Ripper
Chernobyl.description: Created by TGA Subcool, Chernobyl is famous for its nuclear-green buds and radioactive lime flavor. Trainwreck provides the energy while Jack the Ripper adds a sweet citrus kick.

Cookie Crush.lineage: Durban Poison  x  OG Kush -> GSC | Chemdawg  x  Hindu Kush -> OG Kush
Cookie Crush.description: A double dose of the Cookie family's best traits. Girl Scout Cookies brings the sweet, doughy flavor while OG Kush reinforces the potent, relaxing backbone.

Death Star.lineage: Afghani indica hybrid -> Sensi Star | Chemdawg  x  Mass Super Skunk  x  Northern Lights -> Sour Diesel
Death Star.description: Named for its ability to destroy stress. Sensi Star brings the indica weight while Sour Diesel adds a sativa-leaning cerebral sparkle and pungent fuel aroma.

Garlic Budder.lineage: Chemdawg  x  GSC -> GMO (Garlic Mushroom Onion) | Do-Si-Dos  x  Mendo Breath -> Peanut Butter Breath
Garlic Budder.description: For the savory palate -- GMO's unmistakable garlic funk meets the creamy, nutty smoothness of Peanut Butter Breath. One of the most unique flavor profiles in the game.

GG#4.genetics: Chem's Sister  x  Sour Dubb  x  Chocolate Diesel
GG#4.lineage: Chemdawg sibling -> Chem's Sister | Sour Diesel phenotype -> Sour Dubb | Sour Diesel  x  Chocolate Trip -> Chocolate Diesel
GG#4.description: The legendary GG#4 (Gorilla Glue) -- an accidental cross that became one of cannabis' most celebrated strains. Named for the resin that sticks to everything during trimming.

Green Crack.lineage: Originally named 'Cush' -- renamed by Snoop Dogg for its energizing effects. Descended from Skunk #1 lineage with possible Sweet Leaf/Afghani genetics
Green Crack.description: The ultimate wake-and-bake strain. Delivers a tangy, fruity flavor and sharp mental energy. Snoop renamed it for the intense, invigorating rush it delivers.

Headband.lineage: Chemdawg  x  Hindu Kush -> OG Kush | Chemdawg  x  Mass Super Skunk  x  Northern Lights -> Sour Diesel
Headband.description: Named for the subtle pressure you feel around your temples -- like wearing an invisible headband. Two of cannabis' greatest strains combine for smooth, long-lasting effects.

Jealousy.lineage: Sunset Sherbet  x  Thin Mint GSC -> Gelato 41 | GSC  x  Pink Panties -> Sherbert
Jealousy.description: Bred by Seed Junky Genetics, Jealousy lives up to the hype. Dense, purple-tinted buds deliver a creamy, candy-like flavor and perfectly balanced effects.

Jet Fuel Gelato.lineage: Aspen OG  x  High Country Diesel -> Jet Fuel | Sunset Sherbet  x  Thin Mint GSC -> Gelato
Jet Fuel Gelato.description: High-octane meets creamy dessert. Jet Fuel brings the gas-forward punch while Gelato smooths it out with sweet, creamy undertones. A premium hybrid experience.

Kush Mintz.lineage: Thin Mint GSC  x  Fire OG  x  Animal Cookies -> Animal Mints | OG Kush  x  Afghani -> Bubba Kush
Kush Mintz.description: Seed Junky's masterpiece. The Animal Mints gives it that frosty mint flavor while Bubba Kush adds old-school body sedation. A modern classic with legendary parents.

Lemon Pound Cake.lineage: Lemon Joy  x  Skunk #1 -> Lemon Skunk | Skunk #1 phenotype -> Cheese
Lemon Pound Cake.flavor: Lemon zest, buttery cake, sweet cream
Lemon Pound Cake.description: Exactly what it sounds like -- a rich, buttery lemon cake flavor that coats the palate. The Lemon Skunk parentage provides zesty brightness while Cheese adds depth and body.

Liberty Haze.lineage: Government G13 (legendary Afghani indica)  x  ChemDawg 91 (Chemdawg phenotype) -- bred by Barney's Farm, 2011 Cannabis Cup winner
Liberty Haze.description: A Cannabis Cup champion from Barney's Farm. The mythical G13 brings potency while ChemDawg 91 adds electric sativa energy. Named for the freedom it gives your mind.

Northern Lights.lineage: Pure Afghani indica landrace  x  Thai sativa landrace -- originally cultivated in Seattle, perfected by Sensi Seeds in the Netherlands in the 1980s
Northern Lights.description: One of the most famous indicas ever created. Northern Lights has been a cornerstone of cannabis breeding since the 1980s -- a two-time Cannabis Cup winner and parent to countless hybrids.

NYC Diesel.lineage: Soma Seeds creation -- Mexican sativa landrace  x  Afghani indica with possible Sour Diesel influence. A New York City staple since the early 2000s
NYC Diesel.description: Born in the Big Apple. NYC Diesel captures the electric energy of the city in a joint -- bright citrus and diesel fuel aroma with a creative, social buzz that keeps the conversation flowing.

NYC Kush.lineage: NYC Diesel (Mexican Sativa  x  Afghani)  x  OG Kush (Chemdawg  x  Hindu Kush) -- a potent cross blending NYC's signature diesel funk with the legendary OG Kush backbone
NYC Kush.flavor: Diesel, earthy pine, sweet citrus, spice
NYC Kush.effects: Heavy relaxation, euphoric, cerebral, stress relief
NYC Kush.description: The best of both coasts collide. NYC Diesel's electric cerebral energy meets OG Kush's legendary body-melting potency. A powerhouse indica-leaning hybrid that hits hard at 30%+ THC -- true New York muscle.

Skywalker OG.lineage: Blueberry  x  Mazar I Sharif -> Skywalker | Chemdawg  x  Hindu Kush -> OG Kush
Skywalker OG.description: The force is strong with this one. Skywalker's Blueberry-Afghan heritage meets the unmatched potency of OG Kush for a deeply sedating experience that sends you to a galaxy far, far away.

Sour Lemons.lineage: Chemdawg  x  Mass Super Skunk  x  NL -> Sour Diesel | Lemon Skunk  x  OG Kush -> Lemon OG
Sour Lemons.flavor: Sharp lemon, sour diesel, citrus peel
Sour Lemons.description: A citrus explosion that hits you right between the eyes. Sour Diesel's legendary energy gets a lemon-forward twist from Lemon OG. Perfect for daytime productivity.

Space Candy.lineage: Romulan  x  Cinderella 99 -> Space Queen | Lavender  x  Power Plant -> Cotton Candy
Space Candy.description: A whimsical sativa that tastes like a candy shop in outer space. Space Queen brings the cosmic energy while Cotton Candy adds layers of sweetness and floral complexity.

Trainwreck.lineage: Mexican sativa  x  Thai sativa  x  Afghani indica -- originated in Northern California's Emerald Triangle, named for its intense, fast-hitting effects
Trainwreck.description: A legendary NorCal strain that hits you like its name suggests. Three landrace genetics combine for a spicy, pine-forward sativa that delivers immediate cerebral stimulation.

Wedding Cake.genetics: Cherry Pie  x  Girl Scout Cookies
Wedding Cake.lineage: Granddaddy Purple  x  Durban Poison -> Cherry Pie | OG Kush  x  Durban Poison -> GSC
Wedding Cake.description: Also known as Pink Cookies -- a powerhouse that tastes like a slice of wedding cake. Cherry Pie brings fruity sweetness while GSC adds the beloved cookie dough flavor and balanced effects.

White Fire OG.lineage: OG Kush  x  SFV OG -> Fire OG | Unknown triangle cross -> The White (famous for trichome production)
White Fire OG.description: WiFi OG -- where Fire OG's intense potency meets The White's legendary frost. Known for snowcapped buds and a clean, peppery diesel flavor that cannabis connoisseurs chase.

Zoap.lineage: Champagne  x  Blackberry -> Rainbow Sherbet | Unknown exotic cross -> Pink Guava (Deep East Oakland genetics by Deo Farms)
Zoap.description: Bred by DEO Farms, Zoap took the cannabis world by storm. Its unique soapy-floral-fruit flavor is unlike anything else. Rainbow Sherbet brings color while Pink Guava adds exotic sweetness.

Banana Bash.lineage: Ghost OG  x  Skunk Haze -> Banana Kush | Hindu Kush landrace -- enhanced with live resin concentrate for amplified potency
Banana Bash.flavor: Banana cream, sweet tropical, earthy hash
Banana Bash.description: An infused powerhouse. The Banana Kush base delivers sweet tropical flavor, amplified with concentrate for an elevated experience. Not for beginners.

Blueberry Banana Waffles.lineage: DJ Short's Blueberry (Afghani  x  Thai  x  Purple Thai)  x  Banana OG -- infused with premium concentrate
Blueberry Banana Waffles.description: Breakfast in a joint. DJ Short's legendary Blueberry meets Banana OG, then gets infused for maximum impact. The flavor literally tastes like blueberry banana waffles.

Just Peachy.lineage: Gelatti  x  Kush Mints -> Georgia Pie | Unknown exotic cross -> Peach Ringz -- enhanced with live resin
Just Peachy.flavor: Fresh peach, candy rings, sweet cream
Just Peachy.description: Georgia Pie's candy-forward genetics meet Peach Ringz for a fruity experience that tastes exactly like the candy. Infusion pushes potency into the stratosphere.

Lychee Dream.lineage: Exotic lychee-flavored cultivar crossed with dreamy sativa genetics -- infused with premium concentrate for enhanced potency
Lychee Dream.description: An exotic sativa-leaning infused preroll that captures the unmistakable sweetness of fresh lychee fruit. The infusion adds layers of potency while maintaining the delicate flavor profile.

Strawberry Kiwi.lineage: Strawberry Fields  x  Haze -> Strawberry Cough | Kiwi-flavored OG phenotype -> Kiwi Kush -- infused with concentrate
Strawberry Kiwi.flavor: Fresh strawberry, kiwi tang, sweet berry
Strawberry Kiwi.description: The classic juice box flavor in an infused joint. Strawberry Cough's legendary berry flavor gets a tropical twist from Kiwi Kush, then concentrated infusion takes it next level.

Watermelon Skittlez.lineage: Watermelon phenotype  x  Zkittlez (Grape Ape  x  Grapefruit) -- infused with premium live resin concentrate
Watermelon Skittlez.description: Summer in an infused preroll. The Watermelon phenotype brings juicy, refreshing flavor while Zkittlez adds that famous rainbow fruit candy sweetness. Infusion makes it a heavy hitter.

Chem 91.lineage: One of the original Chemdawg cuts -- secured at a Grateful Dead concert in 1991. The genetic ancestor of OG Kush, Sour Diesel, and countless modern strains
Chem 91.description: Cannabis royalty. Chem 91 is THE original Chemdog cut from the Grateful Dead era -- the genetic foundation that birthed OG Kush and Sour Diesel. Pure East Coast history in every nug.

Banana Cream Pie.lineage: Banana Kush  x  OG Kush -> Banana OG | Starfighter  x  GSC -> Cookies & Cream
Banana Cream Pie.flavor: Banana cream, vanilla custard, sweet dough
Banana Cream Pie.description: Dessert genetics at their finest. Banana OG's tropical sweetness meets Cookies & Cream's rich vanilla. Like eating a banana cream pie that melts every muscle in your body.

Black Maple.genetics: Black Diamond  x  Maple Leaf Indica
Black Maple.lineage: Blackberry  x  Diamond OG -> Black Diamond | Afghani landrace selection -> Maple Leaf Indica (Sensi Seeds)
Black Maple.flavor: Dark maple syrup, earthy, sweet berry
Black Maple.description: A dark, mysterious indica that pours like liquid maple. Black Diamond's purple, berry-forward profile meets Maple Leaf's old-school Afghani warmth for a nighttime knockout.

Candy Fumez.lineage: London Pound Cake  x  Gushers -> Candy Rain | Sherbinski's Grapefruit phenotype selection
Candy Fumez.description: A candy store meets a gas station in the best way possible. The London Pound Cake lineage in Candy Rain brings sweetness while Grapefruit adds a bright citrus-gas contrast.

Carbon Fiber.lineage: Cherry Pie  x  Grape Stomper -> Grape Pie | Gelato 25  x  South Florida OG -> Biscotti
Carbon Fiber.description: Sleek, potent, and engineered for performance -- just like its namesake material. Grape Pie brings the fruity density while Biscotti adds toasted, nutty complexity.

Dulce De Uva.lineage: Grape-dominant exotic phenotype  x  Dulce (sweet Latin-inspired cultivar)
Dulce De Uva.description: The name says it all -- 'Grape Sweetness' in Spanish. Rich grape jam flavor with caramel undertones. An indica that wraps you in a warm, dreamy sweetness.

GSC.lineage: Chemdawg  x  Hindu Kush -> OG Kush | South African sativa landrace -> Durban Poison -- originally bred by the Cookie Family in San Francisco
GSC.description: Girl Scout Cookies -- the strain that launched a thousand crosses. Born in San Francisco, GSC changed cannabis forever. OG Kush's potency meets Durban Poison's euphoric energy.

Jelly Donut.lineage: Mendo Breath  x  Do-Si-Dos -> Jelly Breath | Face Off OG  x  OGKB -> Dosidos
Jelly Donut.flavor: Sweet berry jam, doughy, sugar glaze
Jelly Donut.description: The flower version of the preroll favorite. Dense, purple buds that smell exactly like a fresh jelly donut. Mendo Breath genetics bring heavy relaxation with a sweet, jammy finish.

Lemon Cherry Gelato.genetics: Sunset Sherbet  x  Girl Scout Cookies  x  (Lemon  x  Cherry)
Lemon Cherry Gelato.lineage: Part of the Gelato family -- Sunset Sherbet  x  Thin Mint GSC base with lemon and cherry phenotype expression selected by Backpackboyz
Lemon Cherry Gelato.flavor: Lemon zest, cherry candy, creamy gelato
Lemon Cherry Gelato.description: The most hyped Gelato phenotype in recent years. Bright lemon and cherry flavors shine through a creamy gelato base. The buds are dense, purple, and absolutely caked in trichomes.

Nascar.lineage: Chemdawg  x  GSC -> GMO | Unknown high-octane sativa cross -> Trophy Wife
Nascar.description: Pedal to the metal. Nascar takes GMO's pungent garlic gas and adds Trophy Wife's racing sativa energy. Named for the speed at which the effects hit you -- full throttle from the first pull.

Pinnacle.lineage: Zkittlez  x  Gelato -> Runtz | Sunset Sherbet  x  Thin Mint GSC -> Gelato
Pinnacle.description: The name says it all -- this is the peak. Runtz's candy sweetness meets Gelato's creamy smoothness. Dense, colorful buds deliver what might be the most enjoyable smoke in the Dragonfly lineup.

Creme De Menthe.lineage: Animal Mints  x  Bubba Kush -> Kush Mints | Sunset Sherbet  x  Thin Mint GSC -> Gelato
Creme De Menthe.description: An after-dinner mint in flower form. Kush Mints brings the cool minty frost while Gelato adds creamy sweetness. Premium full ounce for the true connoisseur.

Frost.lineage: Frozen Gelato  x  Ice Cream Cake -> Ice Cap | Gorilla Butter phenotype -> White Truffle
Frost.description: Named for the blanket of trichomes that makes every nug look frozen. Ice Cap's icy gelato genetics meet White Truffle's rare, creamy funk. Premium quality at scale.

HDG.lineage: Heavy-hitting indica genetics -- bred for maximum potency, density, and resin production
HDG.description: HDG -- Heavy Duty hits different. Bred for people who need the strongest indica in the room. Dense, frosty nugs that deliver uncompromising relaxation in a full ounce.

Wedding Crasher.lineage: Cherry Pie  x  GSC -> Wedding Cake | Larry OG  x  Granddaddy Purple -> Purple Punch
Wedding Crasher.flavor: Sweet vanilla, grape candy, creamy cake
Wedding Crasher.description: Crashing the party with style. Wedding Cake's sweet vanilla meets Purple Punch's grape candy for an irresistible combination. The life of every smoke session.

Blue Razz.genetics: Blue Raspberry terpene profile (Blue Dream lineage)
Blue Razz.lineage: Blueberry  x  Haze inspired terpene blend -- blue raspberry candy flavor engineered from natural cannabis terpenes
Blue Razz.flavor: Blue raspberry candy, sweet berry, tart
Blue Razz.description: The blue raspberry experience perfected for vape. Inspired by Blue Dream genetics, this captures the iconic candy shop flavor with a bright, energizing sativa buzz.

Double Bubble OG.lineage: Indiana Bubble Gum  x  OG Kush -- old-school bubblegum genetics meet modern OG potency
Double Bubble OG.description: That classic bubblegum flavor from the bag you used to get at the corner store -- now in a vape. Indiana Bubble Gum genetics meet OG Kush's legendary relaxation.

Electric Watermelon OG.lineage: Watermelon phenotype  x  OG Kush -- electrified watermelon flavor with classic OG backbone
Electric Watermelon OG.flavor: Sweet watermelon, electric citrus, earthy OG
Electric Watermelon OG.description: Watermelon that hits you with a jolt. The watermelon phenotype's juicy sweetness gets an OG Kush backbone for balance. Like biting into a watermelon that bites back.

Forbidden Fruit.lineage: Granddaddy Purple  x  Durban Poison -> Cherry Pie | California Orange  x  Skunk -> Tangie
Forbidden Fruit.description: The most exotic fruit salad you'll ever taste. Cherry Pie's berry sweetness meets Tangie's tropical citrus for a flavor so good it feels like it shouldn't be allowed.

Lemon Drop.lineage: Lemon Skunk  x  OG Kush -> Lemon OG | Chemdawg  x  MSSS  x  NL -> Sour Diesel
Lemon Drop.flavor: Sharp lemon candy, sour, sweet citrus
Lemon Drop.description: Pure lemon candy energy in a vape. Lemon OG brings the citrus bomb while Sour Diesel adds sativa fuel. Like squeezing a lemon straight into your brain -- in a good way.

Rainbow Beltz.lineage: Grape Ape  x  Grapefruit -> Zkittlez | Zkittlez  x  Do-Si-Dos -> Moonbow
Rainbow Beltz.description: Tastes exactly like the sour candy belt. Zkittlez appears on both sides of the lineage for double the fruit, while Moonbow adds exotic complexity. A candy lover's dream.

Red Razzleberry.lineage: Raspberry-forward phenotype selection  x  White Widow  x  Blueberry -> Berry White
Red Razzleberry.flavor: Red raspberry, mixed berry, sweet tart
Red Razzleberry.description: Red berry explosion. The raspberry phenotype delivers intense, authentic berry flavor while Berry White adds smooth, creamy sweetness. A fruit-forward sativa you'll keep hitting.

Green Apple.lineage: Green apple phenotype of Runtz -- Zkittlez  x  Gelato with selected green apple terpene expression
Green Apple.flavor: Sour green apple, candy, tart citrus
Green Apple.description: Sour green apple candy in a cart. This Runtz phenotype was selected specifically for its bright, tart apple flavor. Sativa energy with candy shop appeal.

Orange Creamsicle.lineage: California Orange  x  Blueberry -> Orange Crush | Afghani  x  Thai -> Juicy Fruit
Orange Creamsicle.flavor: Creamy orange, vanilla ice cream, tangy
Orange Creamsicle.description: The ice cream truck in a cart. Orange Crush's bright citrus meets Juicy Fruit's tropical sweetness for a creamy, dreamy vape that tastes like summer childhood.

Papaya Punch.lineage: Citral #13  x  Ice #2 -> Papaya | Larry OG  x  Granddaddy Purple -> Purple Punch
Papaya Punch.flavor: Tropical papaya, grape punch, sweet cream
Papaya Punch.description: A tropical knockout. Papaya's exotic fruit sweetness gets amped up with Purple Punch's grape candy power. Close your eyes and you're on a hammock somewhere warm.

Melted Strawberries.lineage: Strawberry phenotype  x  Guava cross -> Strawberry Guava | Sunset Sherbet  x  Thin Mint GSC -> Gelato
Melted Strawberries.description: Like strawberries left in the sun -- warm, sweet, and dripping with flavor. The 14-pack gives you this premium hybrid experience for sharing or savoring all week.
